usage.outputShape: body.web.results[] (each {title, url, description}); also body.faq.results[] for FAQ-style answers; body.query echoes the parsed query
quirks: Params are query-string, not a JSON body: pass ?q=...&count=... on the URL.
Response is large (~110KB for count=3) and richly structured (web, faq, query, etc.) — Brave's native API shape, not flattened.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.signalfuse.co/v1/gateway/search/brave with query params q (the search query, required) and count (number of web results, optional, default 10, max 20). Pays $0.008 USDC per call over x402 on Base. Read the web results from body.web.results[] — each has title, url, and description. FAQ-style answers, when present, are at body.faq.results[]. Plain synchronous response; no auth or polling needed.
